title: nan
authors: Rajasekaran A.; Meles M.; Virrankoski R.; Jäntti R.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV localization algorithm in GNSS-denied environments using angle-of-departure from a single base station fused with IMU/barometer dead-reckoning via an extended Kalman filter, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
